mcpServerOpenaiFormElicitation.description:
Legacy opt-in for the `openai/form` MCP extension.

New clients should declare `openai/form` in [`Self::extensions`].

optOutNotificationMethods.description:
Exact notification method names that should be suppressed for this
connection (for example `thread/started`).

allowProviderModelFallback.description:
Allow a provider with an authoritative static model catalog to replace an unavailable
requested model with its default.

runtimeWorkspaceRoots.description: Replace the thread's runtime workspace roots. Paths must be absolute.

approvalsReviewer.description:
Override where approval requests are routed for review on this thread
and subsequent turns.

permissions.description: Named profile id for this thread. Cannot be combined with `sandbox`.

historyMode.description: Persisted thread history contract to use for this new thread.

threadSource.description: Optional client-supplied analytics source classification for this thread.

projectId.description:
Optional project identity for this new thread. Durable threads persist
the assignment; ephemeral threads expose it only in live responses.

environments.description:
Optional sticky environments for this thread.

Omitted selects the default environment when environment access is
enabled. Empty disables environment access for turns that do not
provide a turn override. Non-empty selects the first environment as the
current turn environment.

cwd.description:
A UTF-8 path for preserving raw path compatibility at the app-server API
boundary while Codex migrates to [`PathUri`].

Supports storing arbitrary strings read from the API and converting to and
from [`PathUri`] using an explicitly selected native path convention.

When converting from [`PathUri`], "native" refers to the supplied
[`PathConvention`], which may be foreign to the operating system running
this process. The inner string is private so path-producing code must use a
path conversion method instead of bypassing the intended conversion
boundary. Non-UTF-8 paths are converted to UTF-8 lossily because this API
value is serialized as a JSON string.

Deserialization and [`Self::from_string`] accept any UTF-8 string without
interpreting or validating it. Use [`Self::from_string`] when a caller
already owns legacy app-server path text and needs to preserve its wire
spelling; use [`Self::from_path`], [`Self::from_abs_path`], or
[`Self::from_path_uri`] when converting an actual path value. Relative
path text remains valid until an operation such as [`Self::to_path_uri`]
requires an absolute path.

runtimeWorkspaceRoots.description: Environment-native runtime workspace roots. Omitted defaults to `cwd`.

selectedCapabilityRoots.description: Capability roots selected for this thread by the hosting platform.

items.description: A user-selected root that can expose one or more runtime capabilities.

id.description: Stable identifier supplied by the capability selection platform.

location.description: Where the selected root can be resolved.

path.description: Absolute path for the root in the selected environment.

mockExperimentalField.description:
Test-only experimental field used to validate experimental gating and
schema filtering behavior in a stable way.

experimentalRawEvents.description:
If true, opt into emitting raw Responses API items on the event stream.
This is for internal use only (e.g. Codex Cloud).

thread/realtime/start.description: EXPERIMENTAL - start a thread-scoped realtime session.

clientManagedHandoffs.description:
Leaves Codex response handoffs to the client's explicit append calls instead of forwarding
them automatically. Defaults to false.

delegationAckFiller.description:
Controls whether a realtime V3 delegation produces an acknowledgement filler.
Omitted values preserve the Realtime API's default behavior.

flushTranscriptTailOnSessionEnd.description:
Routes any transcript tail remaining at session end through Codex. Defaults to false.
TODO: Remove this rollout knob once transcript-tail flushing is always enabled.

codexResponsesAsItems.description: Sends automatic Codex responses as realtime conversation items instead of handoff appends.

codexResponseItemPrefix.description: Optional prefix added to automatic Codex response items when `codexResponsesAsItems` is true.

codexResponseHandoffMode.description:
Selects how automatic Codex responses are routed in Frameless Bidi sessions. Omitted values
default to `thinking`. Realtime V1 and V2 ignore this setting.

codexResponseHandoffChannelPrefixes.description:
Overrides BEM channel prefixes by `analysis`, `commentary`, or `final`.
Omitted channels retain their default uppercase bracketed prefixes.

model.description: Overrides the configured realtime model for this session only.

outputModality.description:
Selects text or audio output for the realtime session. Transport and voice stay
independent so clients can choose how they connect separately from what the model emits.

includeStartupContext.description: Set to false to start without Codex's startup context. Omitted or null includes it.

initialItems.description:
Adds complete role-bearing text items to the initial Frameless Bidi session history.
This is only supported by realtime V3 and is sent during session startup. Requests are
limited to 128 items and 8,192 estimated text tokens in total.

items.description: EXPERIMENTAL - role-bearing text item included when a realtime V3 session starts.

realtimeStartInstructions.description: Developer instructions given to the backing Codex model when this realtime session starts.

realtimeEndInstructions.description: Developer instructions given to the backing Codex model when this realtime session ends.

sdp.description:
SDP offer generated by a WebRTC RTCPeerConnection after configuring audio and the
realtime events data channel.

callId.description: Identifier of a realtime call already created and negotiated by the client.

version.description: Overrides the configured realtime protocol version for this session only.

thread/realtime/appendText.description: EXPERIMENTAL - append text input to thread realtime.

thread/realtime/appendSpeech.description: EXPERIMENTAL - append speakable text to thread realtime.

refreshToken.description:
When `true`, requests a proactive token refresh before returning.

In managed auth mode this triggers the normal refresh-token flow. In
external auth mode this flag is ignored. Clients should refresh tokens
themselves and call `account/login/start` with `chatgptAuthTokens`.

codexHome.description: Absolute path to the server's $CODEX_HOME directory.

`null` means the thread is not loaded or the server does not expose its selection.
An empty list means no environments are selected. This does not report connection status.

preview.description: Usually the first user message in the thread, if available.

ephemeral.description: Whether the thread is ephemeral and should not be materialized on disk.

section.description: The independently persisted section selected for this thread, if any.

historyMode.description: Persisted thread history contract selected when this thread was created.

modelProvider.description: Model provider used for this thread (for example, 'openai').

model.description:
Current configured model when loaded, otherwise the latest persisted model.
Null when unavailable. This is not per-turn execution telemetry.

reasoningEffort.description:
Current configured reasoning effort when loaded, otherwise the latest persisted effort.
Null when unset or unavailable. This is not per-turn execution telemetry.

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the thread was last updated.

recencyAt.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) used for thread recency ordering.

status.description: Current runtime status for the thread.

path.description: [UNSTABLE] Path to the thread on disk.

originator.description:
Originator recorded when the thread was created, independent of its current client or executor.
Null when the recorded originator is unavailable.

source.description: Origin of the thread (CLI, VSCode, codex exec, codex app-server, etc.).

canAcceptDirectInput.description:
Whether the app server accepts direct turn input for this loaded thread.
`None` means the capability is unavailable, such as for an unloaded stored thread.

threadSource.description: Optional analytics source classification for this thread.

agentNickname.description: Optional random unique nickname assigned to an AgentControl-spawned sub-agent.

agentRole.description: Optional role (agent_role) assigned to an AgentControl-spawned sub-agent.

gitInfo.description: Optional Git metadata captured when the thread was created.

daybreakEnabled.description: Saved Daybreak choice, independent of turn execution. Null if unset.

turns.description:
Only populated on `thread/resume`, `thread/rollback`, `thread/fork`, and `thread/read`
(when `includeTurns` is true) responses.
For all other responses and notifications returning a Thread,
the turns field will be an empty list.

error.description: Only populated when the Turn's status is failed.

`:workspace_roots`.

instructionSources.description: Environment-native paths to instruction source files currently loaded for this thread.

approvalsReviewer.description: Reviewer currently used for approval requests on this thread.

sandbox.description:
Legacy sandbox policy retained for compatibility. Experimental clients
should prefer `activePermissionProfile` for profile provenance.

activePermissionProfile.description:
Named or implicit built-in profile that produced the active
permissions, when known.

id.description:
Identifier from `default_permissions` or the implicit built-in default,
such as `:workspace` or a user-defined `[permissions.<id>]` profile.

extends.description:
Parent profile identifier from the selected permissions profile's
`extends` setting, when present.

ApprovalsReviewer.description:
Configures who approval requests are routed to for review. Examples
include sandbox escapes, blocked network access, MCP approval prompts, and
ARC escalations. Defaults to `user`. `auto_review` uses a carefully
prompted subagent to gather relevant context and apply a risk-based
decision framework before approving or denying the request.
